Nymbot ni ubufasha bw'ubwenge bw'ubukorano (AI) bwite bwubakiye kuri Nostr, ikoranabuhanga rifatuye aho nta muntu uriho ucyitunga. Nta kwiyandikisha kubaho: urufunguzo (keypair) ruremewe ku gikoresho, cyangwa urufunguzo rwa Nostr rwari ruriho rurakoreshwa, kandi urwo rufunguzo ni rwo buringanire (identity), amateka y'ibiganiro, n'umubare w'amafaranga (credit balance). Ubutumwa bwose bwangizwa mu buryo bwihariye (end-to-end encrypted) nk'ikintu cyafashwe mu mpapuro z'impano kuri Nostr, hifashishijwe uburyo bwa ML-KEM ugereranyije n'ubundi buryo busanzwe kugira ngo amakuru yanditswe uyu munsi akomeze kubaho niyo hashingwa mudasobwa zikomeye cyane (quantum computers) mu gihe kizaza. Ibisubizo bishyurwa muri Bitcoin binyuze kuri Lightning, ubutumwa ku butumwa, kandi mu buryo bw'ibanga (anonymous mode), amafaranga akoreshwa akoreshwa nk'amasezerano atagaragara (blind vouchers) kugira ngo serivisi ishobore kwishura ubutumwa ariko itamenya uwo bwo ari we. Nymbot ikora nk'ikoranabuhanga rya webi (web app) ndetse n'uburyo bwihariye kuri Android na iOS, ikoresha uburenganzira bwa AGPL-3.0, kandi yateguranywe na 21 Million LLC. Ni iby'ibanga. Bishyurwa muri Bitcoin. Ni ibyawe gusa.

Protect the key saved on this device wit: Kurinda urufunguzo rwakorewe kuri iki gikoresho ukoresheje ijambo ryihariye (passphrase) cyangwa passkey. Nymbot izagusaba iryo jambo buri gihe yifungura, kandi nta kintu cyose kizajya gishyirwa mu mazi cyangwa ngo kirembeze kugeza igihe yafunguwe. Niba uyibuze, urufunguzo ruri kuri iki gikoresho ntushobora koroshoza, bityo reka urufunguzo rwawe rwa nsec rugaruke ahantu hateguwe neza.

Kurinda urugero rwanditse kuri iki gikoresho ukoresheje ijambo ryihariye. Nymbot izagusaba iryo jambo buri gihe ryifungura, kandi nta kintu cyose kigakorana cyangwa ngo kirembiwe kugeza igihe yafunguye. Iyo wibagiwe, urugero ruri kuri iki gikoresho ntshobora gusubizwa, bityo raba ko uba wubatse nsec yawe ahantu heza kandi hafite umutekano.

Kurinda ikintu cy'ingenzi (key) cyatunganyijwe kuri ubu bwoko bw'icyuma ukoresheje ikiganza cyawe cyangwa ijosi ryawe. Nymbot izagusaba kubikoresha buri gihe igiye gufungurwa, kandi nta kintu na kimwe kizashyirwa mu buryo bwo gusangira cyangwa ngo kirindwe kugeza igihe yafunguye. Nta jambo ry'ibanga rishobora gukoreshwa niba ibyo byaje guhinduka: niba imikoreshereze y'ikiganza cyangwa ijosi ryawe ihindutse, ukeneye nsec yawe n'icyapa cyo gusubiramo (recovery code) byatunganyijwe, bityo bika aho ari hacyo bukeye.
Protection against harvest-now-decrypt-l: Kurinda uburyo bwo "gusya ubu hanyuma ukabica nyuma". Icyatunganyijwe (wrap) cyawe cyashyizweho ibintu byombi X25519 na ML-KEM-768, kandi ibanga rya mbere (shared secret) ryakuwe mu bintu byombi hamwe — bityo umujura w'amakuru wibika aya makuru uyu munsi agomba kurusha lattice hamwe na curve kugira ngo ayasome.

Aba biba kuri ubu gikoresho; amwe make agira uruhare mu kibazo kigize ubutumwa, ajya imbere muri uwo butumwa, afunze nk'ibindi byose utumira. Ibiganiro by'ibanga (ghost chat) ntibivura ayo makuru kandi ntayongeraho.

Imyanzuro ya Nymbot ikunze kubika hagati y'ibiganiro, ibitanzwe rimwe ku rindi kugira ngo buri rimwe rishobore gusomwa, gukosorwa cyangwa gukanwa wenyine. Bibitse kuri ubu gikoresho; ibitoya bifite aho bifite aho bimeze bijya muri uwo mwanya, bishyigikiwe n'uburyo bwo kubika amakuru nk'ibindi byose utumira. Ibiganiro by'ibanga (ghost chat) ntabwo bisoma ibyo, kandi ntabwo na byo bishyiramo ibindi.

Imiterere y'ukuri Nymbot yitwaza hagati y'ibiganiro: izina ryo kugutwita, ibyo ukora, n'uko ukomora ibisubizo. Bikozwe nk'inyandiko imwe kuva imwe kugira ngo ushobore gusoma urutonde, ukandika neza iyo ryamije, ukaba wongera ukakuraho iyari utari gukoresha — incamake igenda ivugururwa ntishobora kwanganwa. Ukuri uvuga mu buryo busanzwe kurebwa kandi bukavugwa buri gihe, ukaba ushobora kukubura n'intego imwe; iyo ufunze uburyo bwo kubibona, ?remember bikomeza gukora. Biba kuri ubu bushyashe, kandi ibyo bimenyesha bike byerekeye ikibazo biba mu rwandiko rw'icyo kibazo. Ikinyandiko cy'ibijyanye n'ibyo (ghost chat) nticyasoma ibyo, kandi nticyongeramo ibindi.
